name: Exclusive Love for You
overview: Shen Yu, the wealthy heiress, is unloved by her parents. Framed by her sister in a staged kidnapping, she is sent to prison. Her father finds her a disgrace, her mother calls her vicious, and her brother says she deserves it. With no love in the family, she cuts ties with them, only to find herself pampered by the heir of Haicheng, Yan Shen. She soon realizes that he has always been a light in her life, illuminating, warming, and healing her in darkest hours—as she is his exclusive love.
